round: 2026-10-07, the records the Scopus searches of amendment AM-7 added
status: AI screening proposals; no human eligibility decision has been made
frame: the 180 records of the priority stratum that no PubMed or ACL query reached. Records Scopus returned that were already in the pool keep the first round's decision and are not re-screened here.
keyed_by: record title, with the pool id and the listing index beside it
eligibility_test: does the record offer a construct, an operational criterion or a measurement method for the quality of a note? This is the test the first round applied, restated here because the first round kept its exclusions as titles only and the reason had to be reconstructed afterwards.

confidence.clear: the abstract states a construct, criterion or method for note quality
confidence.borderline: the record is about note quality but the abstract leaves the measurement unclear, or it is one of the properties of a note without being a study of them. Kept in because a title-and-abstract screen errs towards inclusion, and marked so the human decision can start here.

exclusion_reasons.notes_as_data: The study reads case notes to learn about patients, a service or the care given. The note is its data source and not its object, so it offers no construct, operational criterion or measurement method for the quality of a note.
exclusion_reasons.off_domain_documentation: Documentation quality in another domain: software, engineering, accounting, law, maritime or technical writing. The construct is real there, and the artefact is not a clinical note. Several of these rank highly because the ordering matches the words documentation quality wherever they appear.
exclusion_reasons.broad_ai_review: A broad review of AI or large language models in healthcare that names documentation among many applications and measures no property of a note.
exclusion_reasons.proceedings_volume: A whole conference proceedings indexed as a single record. Scopus does this and PubMed does not, so it is a kind of noise new to this round.
exclusion_reasons.false_positive: The ordering matched words used in an unrelated sense.
exclusion_reasons.other_construct: Documentation of a clinical skill or finding is the subject, but what is judged is the clinical judgement or the care, not the quality of the written record.

what_this_round_adds_to_the_ordering: Scopus searches four fields, including indexed keywords, where the PubMed queries search two. The priority stratum grew by 180 records and 125 of them are excluded, most because they read notes rather than judge them. The share of eligible records in the stratum therefore fell, which is a property of the wider field set and not of the ordering rule, and the rule and its threshold were not changed to compensate.
